subject: Office of Pupil Services FY22 Budget Priorities
overview: The School Committee reviewed the proposed FY22 budget for the Office of Pupil Services, including special education, behavioral health, and nursing. The committee voted to include the superintendent’s recommended staffing and service enhancements in the preliminary budget for final review.

items.title: Budget Framework and ESSER Funding Overview
items.summary: Director of Strategy David Murphy outlined the budget development process, noting approximately $2.1 million in fixed-cost growth and the strategic use of one-time federal ESSER funds to address pandemic-related learning disruptions.

items.title: Office of Pupil Services and Special Education Priorities
items.summary: Director Joan Bowen presented departmental priorities, including adding an Evaluation Team Leader at Andrews Middle School, expanding the Connections program at Roberts Elementary, and providing Orton-Gillingham training for primary teachers.

items.title: Counseling and Behavioral Health Services
items.summary: Staff proposed adding four behavior specialists to support elementary schools and a part-time school counselor specifically for English Learners to address increased social-emotional needs.

items.title: Health Services and Medicaid Billing
items.summary: The health services department requested a dedicated COVID-19 testing team and the establishment of a Medicaid billing team to maximize revenue from school-based health screenings and treatments.

items.title: Curtis Tufts High School Staffing and Infrastructure
items.summary: Requests for the Curtis Tufts High School included expanding elective offerings and addressing critical facility repairs, specifically a failing boiler system.

items.title: Discussion on Staffing Equity and Sustainability
items.summary: Members questioned the distribution of support staff across buildings and debated the long-term sustainability of hiring new personnel using temporary federal grants.

items.title: Approval of Preliminary Pupil Services Recommendations
items.summary: Approved including the superintendent’s draft recommendations for the Office of Pupil Services in the evolving budget for final discussion on May 19th.
